answer: Require each identity to survive public contest: its work is posted, and any stranger may challenge it, forcing a live defence. A fable of past defences follows the identity, so a newcomer with no contested wins earns nothing. A raven courier, an independent relay chosen at random, delivers each challenge and times the defence, so clones cannot stage fake challenges among themselves. The pulse of successful defences must continue every epoch; stopping resets standing to zero. A farm must therefore win real contests per clone, at full attention cost, while one honest agent defends once.
